translations.web: Turn your ear, and listen to the words of the wise. Apply your heart to my teaching.
translations.bsb: Incline your ear and hear the words of the wise— apply your mind to my knowledge—
translations.kjv: Bow down thine ear, and hear the words of the wise, and apply thine heart unto my knowledge.
translations.asv: Incline thine ear, and hear the words of the wise, And apply thy heart unto my knowledge.
